title: Chammanthi
description: Authentic Kerala rustic dry coconut chutney, coarsely ground with small shallots, dried red chillies, garlic, curry leaves, and fragrant coconut oil tempering.

steps.instruction: Blitz small onions, dried red chillies, garlic cloves, curry leaves, and salt in a dry chutney jar.
Add the fresh grated coconut and pulse briefly — keep it very coarse and dry without turning into a wet paste.
In a small pan, heat pure coconut oil, crackle jeera, and pour hot tempering over the ground chammanthi.

storyOrOrigin: A staple comfort food of Kerala homes, paired with hot kanji (rice gruel), kappa, or crispy dosas.
grandmasSecrets: Do not add water while grinding. Pulsing dry yields that distinct, rustic texture.
